mapper.select: SELECT current_database() AS "database" , (SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'vector') AS "pgvectorVersion" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND (table_name LIKE 'analysis\_%' OR table_name LIKE 'rag\_%')) AS "tableCount"
